Services

Ways we can work together

Whether you prefer the depth of one-to-one work or the warmth of a group, there is a path for you.

1-to-1 Coaching

Deeply personalised sessions tailored to your unique journey. We work one-on-one to heal what is holding you back and build the inner life you long for — at your pace, in a safe and confidential space.

  • Fully tailored to your needs and goals
  • Private, confidential and judgement-free
  • Available in Kannada & English

Group Programs & Workshops

Shared healing experiences that build community. Group sessions create a supportive space where participants heal alongside others, often discovering they are far from alone in their struggles.

  • Supportive, community-led healing
  • Practical techniques you can use immediately
  • Ideal for shared learning and connection

Corporate Programs

Wellness initiatives designed for organizational impact. Equip teams with practical tools to manage stress, regulate emotions and work with greater clarity and resilience.

  • Tailored to your organisation’s needs
  • Stress, emotional wellbeing and resilience
  • Measurable impact on team wellbeing

Not sure which is right for you?

That is completely okay. Reach out and we can find the right starting point together.
